title: Stealth (Guard AI)
summary: Guard agent AI as a state machine instead of a behavior tree: three Guard instances patrol a maze, share a spot_player response through the $Aware HSM parent, and use push$/pop$ to investigate a sound and then resume exactly what they were doing.
teaches: HSM parent sharing responses across four sibling states · push$/pop$ as an interruptible subroutine · three composed instances of one agent system
controls: Arrows/WASD move · reach the green exit unseen · P pause · SPACE start · R restart

machines.title: Stealth — the game flow
machines.blurb: $Attract → $Playing → $Caught / $Escaped, with pause as a push$/pop$ interrupt. Owns the three Guard instances and fans every tick out to them; the scene reports perceptions (sightings, touches) back in.

machines.title: Guard — one agent's mind
machines.blurb: The AI core: $Patrolling / $Investigating / $Alerted / $Searching are all children of $Aware, which owns the shared spot_player response — see the player from ANY of the four and you get the same escalation. hear_sound is a push$ interrupt: investigate for a while, then pop$ back to exactly the interrupted patrol compartment. The card tracks guard 1.
